results.title: Giovanni Trapattoni’s Ireland
results.overview: Off the back of the embarrassment that was the qualification campaign for the 2008 European championship, Ireland turned to the expertise of legendary Italian manager Giovanni Trapattoni. During his 5-year reign there were some incredible highs, some dreary lows and a whole lot of draws. The topic of much debate, Trapattoni’s time in Ireland was certainly worth remembering.

results.title: Chloe Radcliffe: Eyes Down Here
results.overview: Chloe Radcliffe takes a hard look at flirting when you don't fit in. She analyzes staring (at her birthmark or other people's boobs), sitting in a stranger's shit, and why Doritos aren't made for women. A special dedicated to anyone who's ever felt overlooked at a party.

results.title: One Perfect Date
results.overview: Emma, a young woman with Down syndrome, navigates life after her father's death, aiming for romance and career success against the backdrop of her overprotective sister Blake. While Emma wishes to find a young man she saw at the funeral, she also seeks to become "employee of the month" at the local grocery store, where Blake's boyfriend, Brad, proves to be an obstacle. Emma faces challenges in love and work, striving to achieve her dreams before her sister intervenes.

results.title: Night of Blood
results.overview: Six strangers enter a cash-prize endurance challenge at the Val Verde Hotel, a location infamous for a fatal explosion and rumors of being haunted. Instead of being stalked by a physical, masked serial killer, the contestants face immersive, supernatural scares when the hauntings at the hotel turn out to be all too real.

results.title: Töst
results.overview: On the 24th of June 2024 mum bought me a toaster, and my life has changed forever.

results.title: Nobody Said Anything
results.overview: Katarina is called to her daughter’s friend’s home to confront the consequences of a seemingly innocent game that has spiraled out of control.

results.title: The Land Demands Blood
results.overview: Water, woods, rock, and drifted stream. Storms overhead, fields of salt water, wicked moor. Lightning strokes and standing stones, ground hard as iron and oak, granite swallowing tin and slate. This documentary special feature examines Hammer Films use of Cornwall as a setting and location for its films, exploring the "new weird Britain" of contemporary Cornish folk horror with filmmakers, playwrights, and historians, and drawing on creative work from the region.

results.title: Her Wrong Face
results.overview: This is a story about a girl searching for her true self. Lele dreams of becoming a ballet dancer, yet she struggles to master an elegant smile. “Come on, smile” echoes in the studio, effortless for others but not her. Day after day, she repeats the steps, seeking the meaning of dance. With her friend May by her side, they return to the stage. An unexpected moment shatters the routine. In the darkness, Lele finds her answer.

results.title: What We Dreamed Of Then
results.overview: A passionate swim coach and dedicated father navigates the turbulent reality of invisible homelessness when he is forced to live out of his van.

results.title: Lady Parts
results.overview: Traci, a gallerist, is relentlessly pursued by a sadistic killer fixated on a painting that once graced her gallery's centerpiece. Following a home invasion, Traci's friends come to offer solace and protection. But as the bodies begin to pile up, Traci is thrust into a desperate search for the painting, knowing it’s the only chance to stop the killer’s relentless slaughter.

results.title: Pandora
results.overview: Some doors are best left unopened.

results.title: Mother Yamuna
results.overview: Behind the Taj Mahal, one of India's most iconic symbols, flows the sacred Yamuna River. However, its waters are among the most polluted in the world. The Yamuna is a severely compromised ecological system. And yet, we remain there, immersed, like boiled frogs…

results.title: Things Greater Than Us
results.overview: A group of friends are thrown for loop when they discover the reason their eccentric millionaire friend invited them to a cabin getaway is to share evidence of intelligent life from elsewhere in the universe.

results.title: Echoes of Deception
results.overview: Brandi, a driven detective, risks everything to save her daughter as dark secrets, family betrayal, and a haunting past collide with a web of trauma.

results.title: Verónica
results.overview: In the midst of gender transition, Verónica runs away from home in search of a new beginning and finds refuge with her cousin Alex. As she navigates her new life, actress Israel, who plays Verónica, faces her own personal journey during filming.

results.title: Cairn
results.overview: Filmed across 100 miles of Scottish wilderness, three estranged friends trek through the Highlands, where guilt, conflict and buried grief force them to confront what they’ve been running from.

results.title: DDT Hybrid Performer 2026 ~Kaisei Takechi 2nd Anniversary Show~
results.original_title: HYBRID PERFORMER 2026～武知海青デビュー2周年記念大会~
results.overview: Hybrid Performer 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by DDT Pro-Wrestling (DDT), commemorating the second anniversary of crossover star Kaisei Takechi's in-ring debut. It took place on February 22, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

results.title: Celestino
results.overview: Ivan, a Belgian journalist on sabbatical in Mexico, starts following the trail of a mysterious writer called Celestino Pérez. Upon arrival in the village where Celestino lives, he turns out to be absent. Ivan is taken in by the writer's family. He soon finds himself trapped in their house, mirroring his own experience with his imagination about Celestino.

results.title: In My Dreams, Or In Ours
results.original_title: In My Dreams, Or In Ours

results.title: Palestinian Unwanted
results.overview: ‘Palestinian Unwanted’ takes place after 7 October 2023 and the ongoing catastrophe in Gaza – a reality unfolding on screen, accompanied by broad political support in the West. Told from the personal perspective of Danish-Palestinian film director Omar Shargawi, we follow his involvement in the Palestinian movement in Denmark. Together with other activists, he confronts politicians and the media and turns his attention to Denmark’s role – from political support and arms exports to a public discourse characterised by silence, one-sidedness and the demonisation of Palestinians.
